borough: London Borough of Hammersmith and Fulham
site_name: Roberts House99 - 103 Hammersmith RoadLondonW14 0QH
description: Variation of condition 2 (approved drawings), 14 (cycle parking) and 15 (refuse storage) of planning permission ref: 2023/01033/FUL granted 3rd September 2024 for the 'Change of use of the first, second and third floor levels from offices (Class E) into 4 x 2 bedroom and 2 x 3 bedroom self-contained flats (Class C3); removal of existing frame and installation of ventilation grille at ground floor level to south eastern elevation; erection of a bin store at the side of the enclosed brick storage to rear courtyard' to allow amendments to the approved drawings to include: external amendments comprising the installation of a new access door to rear elevation, addition of zinc roof canopy to the existing metal frame at the rear entrance area, installation of green roof on the bin store and the existing store, rationalisation of existing plant at roof level and provision of substitute plant to serve the residential units, installation of new plant store at the rear to serve the commercial space, new aov at roof level to service residential lobby at the third floor, and relocation of 2no. short-term cycle parking spaces to the other side of the bin store.
